objective: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

description: The note has stains covering its surface. The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:
...if it were not for General Angerforge's diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...
...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.
Our lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...
progress: <Marshal Windsor eyes the note in your hand.>
completion: <Marshal Windsor takes the note and begins reading.>
